idea-plugin.name: Frost
idea-plugin.description:
Translucent, blurred IDE windows - frosted glass for your IDE, like background-opacity and background-blur in Ghostty or the transparent, blurred windows of iTerm2, Warp and VS Code vibrancy extensions. A transparent background with real blur, without a background image.

  • The whole UI is translucent: main window, editor, tool windows, terminal, toolbars, status bar, popups, tooltips, notifications and dialogs.
  • Real window blur (frosted glass, acrylic-like) rendered by the macOS compositor, so it stays light on resources.
  • Coloured backgrounds (selection, current line, file colours, search results) stay visible, just translucent.
  • Works with any theme - dark or light, bundled or from a plugin.
  • Live preview sliders: UI opacity, floating windows opacity, editor opacity, sticky lines opacity, highlight opacity, blur radius and floating windows blur radius, plus Reset to Defaults.

Settings: Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Frost. Quick toggle: View | Frost.

macOS only for now - on Windows and Linux the plugin does nothing. Turn off Appearance | Background Image while using Frost: the two effects fight each other.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0 - first release.

  • Translucent, blurred main window, popups and dialogs on macOS.
  • Separate opacity and blur for floating windows; editor, sticky lines and highlight opacity.
  • Live preview of every setting.
